name: War-Awoken Star Cyclone (Weapon Skill)
name_jp: 戦醒スターサイクロン
effects:
Single-target Wind/NE piercing hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Wind Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if user has at least 0/10% Wind Boost
WS Blue: Dualcast Wind 3, Instant Wind 3 & Weakess Damage +30% for 3 turns to user
WS Gold: Wind Boost +50% to all allies
